description: IFRS 9 Simplified Approach — ECL provision matrix for trade receivables, IFRS 15 contract assets, and IFRS 16 lease receivables. Ages each receivable into buckets (current / 1-30 / 31-60 / 61-90 / 91-180 / 180+ days past due). Applies the entity's historical loss rates per bucket, adjusted by its stated forwardLookingAdjustment for current conditions and forecasts (IFRS 9.B5.5.35, B5.5.52). Returns per-invoice ECL, portfolio summary, movement schedule (opening − write-offs → closing allowance, P&L charge), and IFRS 7.35H disclosure stub. NOT for the general 3-stage approach (loans, bonds) — use ifr_calculate with standard "ifrs9" for those. Token required; costs 10 credits.

bucketRates.description: Required: a rate for every bucket that holds a receivable. The entity's historical loss rates per ageing bucket, before the forward-looking adjustment (IFRS 9.B5.5.35). Scale DECIMAL_FRACTION: 0.04 is 4 %; a rate below 0 or above 1 is refused (a credit loss cannot exceed the balance).

1_30.description: Loss rate for 1-30 days past due

31_60.description: Loss rate for 31-60 days past due

61_90.description: Loss rate for 61-90 days past due

91_180.description: Loss rate for 91-180 days past due

current.description: Loss rate for not-yet-due receivables, e.g. 0.005

over180.description: Loss rate for 180+ days past due, e.g. 0.50

forwardLookingAdjustment.description: Required. The adjustment of the historical rates for current conditions and forecasts of future conditions (IFRS 9.B5.5.52, 5.5.17(c)), as a decimal fraction applied to every bucket's rate (0.10 raises each rate by 10 %, e.g. 0.04 → 0.044; −0.05 lowers it), or one fraction per bucket. 0 where the entity has assessed the forecasts and they change nothing. State the historical rates and this adjustment — never pre-adjusted rates. Scale DECIMAL_FRACTION (10 % is 0.10, not 10): an adjustment that takes any bucket's rate above 1 is refused.

previousECL.description: Opening loss allowance, for the movement schedule (IFRS 7.35H)

receivables.description: Required, at least one. Portfolio of trade receivables to age and provision

dueDate.description: ISO date — if absent, classified as current

writeOffsInPeriod.description: Required with previousECL: the amounts written off during the period (IFRS 9.5.4.4) — they use the allowance, so the charge is closing − (opening − write-offs); a write-off above the opening allowance is itself a loss. 0 where nothing was written off. Not read without previousECL.

name: ifr_ecl_provision_matrix
